[3:25PM] #EbuteEro #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

 Good movement is observed on the Eko Bridge approaching Apongbon, particularly by the NEPA area. Descending the Eko Bridge towards the CMS proper via the ascending CMS Bridge is clear, allowing for smooth passage. 

Similarly, descending the Eko Bridge towards Elegbeta Mini Stadium and the Ebute Ero market, with connections back to the Eko Bridge, is also free of impediments.

 Furthermore, traffic descending from Carter Bridge, heading towards the Ebute Ero market, Leventis, and through the UBA roundabout to access both inner and outer Marina, is currently moving well. 

Good movement is also observed on the Broad Street stretch, extending to Apongbon underneath the bridge, with connections to Offin Canal market and Olowogbowo.

 The CMS Bridge also has good movement, leading towards the Offin Canal market stretch and the Ijora Olopa by NEPA intersection. As of now, there are no reported impediments, and personnel are on-site managing traffic flow effectively.

#FollowLASTMA

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 11:00 PM, 07 June 2025(Saturday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Bulacan, Metro Manila, Rizal, Batangas and Cavite.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Pampanga, Laguna and Tarlac.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Quezon, Bataan, Zambales and Nueva Ecija which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 AM tomorrow.
